about_the_game: You can experience the Custom Battle Mode, where you combine elements of chess, shogi, reversi, cards, and other mechanics to create your own board game and play against an opponent.
detailed_description: You can experience the Custom Battle Mode, where you combine elements of chess, shogi, reversi, cards, and other mechanics to create your own board game and play against an opponent.
name: Chaos Pieces

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX-6300 equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770 / AMD Radeon R9 280 or better (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600 equivalent or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: You can experience the Custom Battle Mode, where you combine elements of chess, shogi, reversi, cards, and other mechanics to create your own board game and play against an opponent.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Maori
